items.title: Bill Ackman Just Bought Visa, Mastercard, and S&P Global Stock. Each One Collects a Toll on Somebody Else's Sale.
items.summary: Pershing Square's three biggest new stakes are in companies that get paid when somebody else's customer transacts. Together, they were bigger than any single bet in the filing.
